preconditions.description: The number of pairs is at least 2 and at most 2 * 10^5.
The number of colors is at least 2 and at most 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output == 'YES' and is_valid_output(output_lines, n, k))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by $n$ lines of integers representing the colors of the costumes of pairs.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= k and 1 <= g_i <= k for b_i, g_i in output_lines)
invariants.description: Each color of the costume is an integer between 1 and $k$, inclusive.

invariants.expression: all(b_i != g_i for b_i, g_i in output_lines)
invariants.description: No pair has the same color for both man's and woman's costume.

invariants.expression: all(output_lines[i][0] != output_lines[i+1][0] and output_lines[i][1] != output_lines[i+1][1] for i in range(n-1))
invariants.description: For each two consecutive pairs, the colors of the man's and woman's costumes differ.
There are no two pairs with the same man's and woman's costume colors.
